buildFeature.name: Plan a feature
buildFeature.desc: Put a feature on the roadmap. Engineering works through the roadmap in order.
buildFeature.feed: {{feature}} is on the roadmap. Somebody has already drawn it on a whiteboard.

bugBash.name: Bug bash
bugBash.desc: Point most of engineering at bugs this month. Nobody enjoys it; everybody benefits.
bugBash.feed: Bug bash declared. Someone made a leaderboard. Someone else is gaming it.

refactor.name: Refactor
refactor.desc: Pay down tech debt. Output dips this month; everything after gets easier.
refactor.feed: The team is rewriting the bit nobody understands. Again. But properly this time.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: Everyone works late this month. Much more output now; burnout arrives later.
feed: Crunch month. The pizza budget has been tripled and the vibe has been halved.
You announce "a sprint". The team hears "weekends".

userInterviews.name: Talk to users
userInterviews.desc: Sit down with real customers for a week. The next features land better.
userInterviews.feed: Five user interviews. Four said they love it. One said what it actually needs.

launch.name: Launch
launch.desc: Go public with the product. You only get one first impression; quality matters.
launch.feedGood: Launch day lands. Somebody important called it "genuinely useful", which in this industry is a love letter.
launch.feedBad: Launch day lands with a thud. The top comment is a screenshot of your error page.

setPrice.name: Change pricing
setPrice.desc: Set what you charge. Higher prices earn more per customer and slow growth.
setPrice.feed: New pricing is live. The pricing page now has a toggle nobody will use.

securityReview.name: Security review
securityReview.desc: Hire an outside firm to poke at everything. Cheap compared with the alternative.
securityReview.feed: The security auditors found nine issues and one very old password. All fixed.

switchModel.name: Switch business model
switchModel.desc: Change how you make money. Some users won't like it; some will leave.
switchModel.feed: You've switched to {{model}}. The announcement post used the word "evolve" four times.

hackathon.name: Hold a hackathon
hackathon.desc: A day of building anything. Speeds up the current feature and adds a few bugs.
hackathon.feed: Hackathon done. One prototype might ship. Another was a karaoke bot.

allNighter.name: Pull an all-nighter
allNighter.desc: Code through the night yourself. Big push on the current feature, at your own cost.
allNighter.feed: You close the laptop at 5:40am. It works. You're not sure why, which is also how you feel.

designSprint.name: Design sprint
designSprint.desc: A week of sketching, testing and polishing. Quality rises for months.
designSprint.feed: Design sprint finished. The new screens are calm, clear and make the old ones look like a ransom note.

openRole.name: Open a role
openRole.desc: Post a job and get three candidates for that role.
openRole.feed: Job posted for a {{role}}. The first applicant asked if the role is "remote from a boat".

hire.name: Hire
hire.desc: Make an offer. Salary hits your burn from next month; equity comes from the option pool.

fire.name: Let someone go
fire.desc: End someone's employment. Severance is two months' pay; the team will notice.

oneOnOne.name: One-on-one
oneOnOne.desc: Proper time with one person. Their mood lifts and you learn who they really are.
oneOnOne.feed: A long one-on-one. You learned more in an hour than in a month of stand-ups.

giveRaise.name: Give a raise
giveRaise.desc: Raise someone's salary by twelve percent. They'll feel it; so will your burn.
giveRaise.feed: A raise. Their thank-you message had three exclamation marks, which is a lot for an engineer.

grantEquity.name: Grant equity
grantEquity.desc: Give someone 0.5% from the option pool. Cheaper than cash, until it isn't.
grantEquity.feed: Equity granted. They spent the evening working out what it's worth at a billion.

teamOffsite.name: Team offsite
teamOffsite.desc: Take everyone away for two days. Morale up, burnout down, costs per head.
teamOffsite.feed: Offsite complete. Trust falls, a hike, and one very honest conversation by a fire.

setPolicy.name: Change a policy
setPolicy.desc: Turn a company policy on or off. Policies quietly shape everything that follows.
setPolicy.feed: New policy: {{policy}}. The all-hands announcement got twelve emoji reactions and one question.

setOrder.name: Brief an executive
setOrder.desc: Change a VP's standing orders. Free, but they'll only follow one at a time.
setOrder.feed: Your VP has new orders. They nodded in a way that suggests a slide deck is coming.

cofounderTalk.name: Walk with your co-founder
cofounderTalk.desc: An hour away from screens. Rebuilds trust with the person who owns half the problem.
cofounderTalk.feed: "We should do this more often," says your co-founder. You both know you won't.

layoffs.name: Layoffs
layoffs.desc: Let a quarter of the team go. Burn drops; morale and reputation take the hit.
layoffs.timeline: Laid off a quarter of the team

oldNetwork.name: Call your old team
oldNetwork.desc: Ring people from your last company. Two strong engineers will take your call.
oldNetwork.feed: Two old colleagues are interested. One asked if this one will "actually work".

pitchAngels.name: Pitch angels
pitchAngels.desc: Small cheques from individuals. No board seats, lots of advice.

raiseRound.name: Raise a round
raiseRound.desc: Open negotiations with a venture firm. Bigger money, bigger strings.

callInAFavour.name: Call in a favour
callInAFavour.desc: An old business-school friend makes a warm introduction to a fund. Buzz up, door open.

applyForGrant.name: Apply for a grant
applyForGrant.desc: Fill in a forty-page form for non-dilutive money. Decision in two months.
applyForGrant.feed: Grant application submitted. Page 31 asked for your "societal impact narrative". You wrote one.

setMarketingBudget.name: Set marketing budget
setMarketingBudget.desc: Monthly paid acquisition. Weak products buy users who leave.
setMarketingBudget.feed: Marketing budget updated. Somewhere, an ad platform's algorithm cracked its knuckles.

cutCosts.name: Cut costs
cutCosts.desc: Cancel the nice-to-haves for six months. Overheads drop; people notice the oat milk is gone.
cutCosts.feed: Costs cut. The snack drawer now contains one rice cake and a note that says "focus".

investorUpdate.name: Send an investor update
investorUpdate.desc: A crisp monthly email to Margot. Good numbers build trust; honest ones still help.
investorUpdate.feedGood: Margot replied to your update within four minutes: "Love this. Let's talk soon."
investorUpdate.feedMeh: Margot replied to your update with a thumbs-up emoji. You've read it eleven times.

bridgeLoan.name: Ask for a bridge
bridgeLoan.desc: Margot lends you a few months of runway as a convertible note. It costs equity and goodwill.
bridgeLoan.timeline: Took a bridge loan from Hollowpine
bridgeLoan.feed: Bridge funded. Margot's email said "happy to help" and the term sheet said something more specific.

creditCards.name: Max out your credit cards
creditCards.desc: Twenty thousand dollars today. Twenty-six thousand in eight months. Very founder.
creditCards.timeline: Put the company on personal credit cards
creditCards.cause: maxed out your personal credit cards
creditCards.feed: You put the company on four credit cards. One of them gives you air miles, which is something.

pitchJournalist.name: Pitch a story
pitchJournalist.desc: Try to get coverage. Lands better when the product is genuinely good.
pitchJournalist.feedGood: Dana ran the story. Sign-ups spiked and your mum shared it twice.
pitchJournalist.feedBad: Dana passed on the story: "Not quite there yet." Fair.

coffeeWithJournalist.name: Coffee with Dana
coffeeWithJournalist.desc: Off the record, no agenda. Journalists remember who was straight with them.
coffeeWithJournalist.feed: Coffee with Dana. She asked good questions and paid for her own flat white.

messageRival.name: Message Brexton
messageRival.desc: Reach out to your rival. Might ease tension. Might become a screenshot.
messageRival.feed: Brexton replied: "Respect. Let's grab a cold plunge sometime." You are not sure what that means.

conferenceTalk.name: Speak at a conference
conferenceTalk.desc: Take the stage. Reputation and buzz, and a candidate usually comes up to you afterwards.
conferenceTalk.feed: Your talk went well. The Q&A was mostly statements with question marks on the end.

fakeReviews.name: Buy reviews
fakeReviews.desc: Five hundred glowing reviews from people who have never existed.
fakeReviews.feed: Five hundred new five-star reviews. Three mention "great product for my business needs, thank you".

spamGrowthHack.name: Import everyone's contacts
spamGrowthHack.desc: Auto-invite every contact in every user's address book. Growth now, grudges later.
spamGrowthHack.feed: The invite blast went out. Someone's dentist, ex and landlord all joined in an hour.

inflateMetrics.name: Round up the numbers
inflateMetrics.desc: Count anyone who ever opened the app as an active user. Investors will see a better company.
inflateMetrics.timeline: Inflated the metrics in the investor deck
inflateMetrics.cause: inflated the numbers in the investor deck
inflateMetrics.feed: The deck now says "monthly actives". It's technically a definition.

sellUserData.name: Sell anonymised data
sellUserData.desc: A data broker will pay well for your users' behaviour. It's anonymised. Mostly.
sellUserData.timeline: Sold user data to a broker
sellUserData.cause: sold user data to a broker
sellUserData.feed: The broker paid promptly. Their invoice described the data as "rich".

poachFromRival.name: Poach from {{rival}}
poachFromRival.desc: Approach two of their best engineers with a generous offer. Brexton will take it personally.
poachFromRival.feed: Two engineers from {{rival}} are interested. One asked if you also have a cold plunge.

writeValues.name: Write the company values
writeValues.desc: Decide what you stand for before you're too big to agree. Matters more than it sounds.
writeValues.feed: Values written. Five of them. Nobody suggested "synergy", which you take as a sign.

retainLawyer.name: Retain a lawyer
retainLawyer.desc: A good startup lawyer on retainer. Opens doors when trouble comes knocking.
retainLawyer.feed: You now have a lawyer. Her first advice was to stop calling things "basically legal".

boardDinner.name: Board dinner
boardDinner.desc: Wine, steak and alignment. Takes the edge off board tension.
boardDinner.feed: Board dinner. Margot told a story about a founder who "didn't listen". You listened.

donateToCause.name: Donate to a cause
donateToCause.desc: Give two percent of cash to a cause the team picks. Good for morale and for your conscience.
donateToCause.feed: The team chose a coding school for kids. The thank-you letter is now on the fridge.
